title: Prospect results
description: The accounts and contacts the run returned, as two flat lists in the same order as the results it wrote, so a later step can act on the rows without reading the document. Only a name is required on a row: every other field is filled when a tool returned it and left out or null otherwise, never made up.

accounts.description: One row per returned account. Empty when nothing qualified.

domain.description: The account's website domain. Contacts point at their account by this.

logoUrl.description: The company's logo image, as a tool returned it.

founded.description: The year the company was founded.

qualification.description: The configured qualification's actual result. unknown when it was not run or could not decide.

score.description: The qualification's overall score, when it returned one.

fitReason.description: One sentence on why the account fits or does not.

contacts.description: One row per person discovered, across every account. Empty or left out for company-only results.

companyDomain.description: The domain of the account this person belongs to, matching an account row.

profileUrl.description: The person's public profile link, as a tool returned it.

photoUrl.description: The person's profile photo, as a tool returned it.

email.description: Only an address a tool returned; never guessed.

qualification.description: The person qualification's actual result, when one was run.

roleReason.description: One sentence on why this person is the one to reach, from the role evidence.

requested.description: How many results were asked for, when a number was given.

shortfall.description: When fewer rows are returned than asked for, or rows were left out to fit what the host accepts: why and how many, in one or two plain sentences. Null otherwise.
